COURT GRANTS DEFENDANT TO APPEAR AT THE NEXT HEARING VIA ZOOMGOV MUST COMPLY WITH THE COURTS RULES ON SUBMITTING EVIDENCE. IF THE DEFENDANT DOES NOT APPEAR AT THE CONTINUED HEARING EITHER IN PERSON OR ON ZOOM PLAINTIFF SHOULD BE GRANTED A DEFAULT JUDGMENT. THE COURT FINDS PROOF OF SERVICE IS SOUND, NO FURTHER SERVICE IS REQUIRED. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: DAVID FLEISIG; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED. (D506)
